== Notes ==
* The [[Black Diamond]] traders were added in the [[Game updates/2017-11-07|November 7th, 2017]] update. Thereafter, drop rates for Sunset Jewels appear to have been reduced.
* A Sunset Jewel was quietly added (likely in the same update or shortly after) to most [[Path of Fire]] collection trinkets, making a limited number more easily obtainable through salvage. Existing trinkets did not receive the upgrade.
